newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish bourse continuous trade may add 10 stocks.
newsitem.headline: Polish bourse continuous trade may add 10 stocks.

text.p: The Polish bourse in the next few months might add about 10 stocks to the 22 already trading in its continuous trading system, the bourse's president said on Wednesday.
"We expect that there will be more than 30 in the coming months," Wieslaw Rozlucki told reporters. But he said no definite decision had been taken. @

Rozlucki also said the bourse planned by the end of April to pass a motion introducing new criteria for firms to be admitted to live trade, the main one being a firm's listing on the exchange's main market.
Another would be a stock's level of turnover at the order balancing session after price fixing.
"In continuous trade we want to have firms which are going to be actively traded," Rozlucki said.
Currently a stock's market capitalisation is also a main criterion to determine if it will trade live.
